**Generated by: Guest Experience skill**

**Total stays:** 89
**Guest Experience Lead:** Mia Tanaka
**Report date:** May 5, 2026

---

## Executive Summary

April delivered the strongest guest experience month YTD: **NPS 64**, **CSAT 4.82**, and a **save-rate of 88%** on in-stay issues. AI Ambassador handled 94.3% of guest messages without human escalation, and the upsell engine attached on 19.4% of stays (vs. 22% target). Two themes need attention: **inconsistent hot tub temperature reports** at 4 cabin properties (HVAC root cause investigated, vendor fix scheduled), and **slow Wi-Fi reports at PC-23** (Jordanelle Sunset) — router upgrade scheduled May 15.

## 3. Top 3 Things Guests Loved (April)

Based on free-text analysis of 67 survey responses + review text (themes ranked by mention frequency):

### 1. AI Ambassador concierge / texting (mentioned by 58% of respondents)

By far the most-praised feature this month. Guests cited speed of response, accuracy of the property-specific answers, and the lack of an app to download.

> "Mia (or whoever was on the other end of the texts) was incredible. I asked about the master bedroom thermostat at 9:30 PM and got an answer in less than 30 seconds. Felt like having a hotel concierge but better." — guest at PC-09 (Hawkfeather Cabin)

> "I texted asking for a kid-friendly restaurant and got 4 specific picks with drive times. Saved our vacation evening." — guest at PC-21 (The Boathouse)

### 2. Cleanliness on arrival (52%)

A 4.91 / 5.00 score is the strongest cleanliness signal in 12 months. Diego's pre-arrival readiness sweep is paying off — every property hits a 24-hour pre-arrival check now.

> "The cabin was spotless. Bathroom corners, fridge, behind the couch — they cleaned places I forgot to check at my own house." — guest at PC-12 (Silvertip Cabin)

### 3. Pre-arrival communication and welcome books (44%)

Specifically, the T-1 SMS with the door code, Wi-Fi, and "60-second tour" was the single most-mentioned pre-arrival touch.

> "By the time I pulled up, I knew where to park, where the keys were, and what time the kids could swim. They thought of everything." — guest at PC-22 (Reservoir Bluff)

## 4. Top 3 Complaints (April)

### 1. Hot tub temperature inconsistency — 4 cabins (mentioned by 12% of respondents in cabin segment)

Guests at PC-09, PC-12, PC-14, and PC-16 reported hot tubs that ran 6–10°F below the 102°F target. Issue is intermittent — passes vendor inspection, fails guest test.

> "Hot tub felt like a warm bath. Was supposed to be 102 — felt closer to 92. Had to wait 4 hours for it to recover after we got in." — guest at PC-12

**Root cause** (per Diego's vendor diagnostic May 4): the smart-control firmware on Sundance hot tubs (4 of 6 portfolio units use this brand) is dropping target temperature after a low-flow event. Sundance has a firmware patch released March 2026 — we hadn't pushed it.

**Fix:** Sundance vendor onsite May 14, applies firmware update + cleans flow sensors at all 4 properties. Estimated cost $480 total. AI Ambassador will proactively alert future guests if temp drops below 100°F.

### 2. Slow Wi-Fi at PC-23 (Jordanelle Sunset) (mentioned by 8% of respondents at this property)

Jordanelle Sunset is a 5BR / 4BA property with a meshed network that doesn't fully cover the lower deck and the bonus room above the garage.

> "Wi-Fi was great in the main rooms but useless in the bonus room and on the deck. Kids wanted to use the bonus room as a movie space and ended up watching downloaded shows." — guest at PC-23

**Fix:** Router upgrade scheduled May 15 (Eero Pro 6e mesh, 6 nodes — covers 5,200 sq ft). Cost $940, charged to owner per existing capex agreement. Marketing to update listing description to remove "high-speed Wi-Fi throughout" pending fix.

### 3. Friend-group bookings — noise + parking issues (mentioned by 22% of friend-group guests, 4% portfolio)

Three of our 18 friend-group bookings in April had complaints: 2 noise reports from neighbors (PC-15, PC-19), 1 parking violation (PC-15) — all in Old Town. NPS for friend-group was 54 vs. 67 for couples.

**Fix:** Riley updated min-stay rules for Old Town properties (2-night min for Fri–Sun protects HOA quiet-hours); pre-arrival sequence for friend-group bookings now includes an explicit 10 PM quiet-hours reminder + a "$150 HOA fine" line. Tested in late-April bookings — zero new noise complaints in last 14 days.

| Pack-and-play ($25) | 33 (family stays) | 33% (11) | $275 |
| Grocery delivery (markup 30%) | 12 (requested) | 67% (8) | $640 (gross), $192 (margin) |
| Restaurant reservation help | 24 | 100% — concierge service, no fee | $0 (NPS lift) |
| **Total upsell revenue** | | | **$5,572** (vs. $7,200 target) |
| **Upsell attach rate (any SKU)** | | **19.4%** | (vs. 22% target) |

**April upsell revenue per stay:** $62.61 (target $80).

### What's working
- **Stocked-fridge starter** is the breakout SKU — 21% attach, $1,615 in margin. Low effort for guest, high perceived value, simple for cleaner to execute.
- **Pack-and-play** at 33% attach for family stays — should add high-chair as a bundle.

### What's not
- **Mid-stay clean** at 11% — guests don't see it as essential. Test: re-frame as "fresh sheets + towels mid-stay" rather than "cleaning."
- **Late check-out** at 18% — could be 30% if we drop the price to $50 mid-week and price-discriminate weekend at $75.

## 8. Notable Save-Stories (April)

### Case A — PC-04 (Eagle's Perch), Apr 14–18

Guest texted at 11:48 PM: "Hot tub is FREEZING and we drove 8 hours for this." AI Ambassador responded in 22 sec with the "I'm escalating immediately, Mia is on her way to her phone" message. Mia called at 11:53 PM from her cell. By 7 AM next day Diego had the Sundance vendor onsite. Guest received: a $200 stay credit + a complimentary mid-stay clean + a Pinecrest swag bag delivered Day 2. **Outcome:** 5-star review, NPS 9, mentioned "the response was incredible — they fixed it before we got out of bed."

### Case B — PC-21 (The Boathouse), Apr 22–25

Family of 5 arrived to a kids' bedroom that smelled musty (HVAC return had a clogged filter). Guest texted at 5:14 PM. AI Ambassador escalated; Diego dispatched cleaner with a backup HVAC filter; new filter installed by 6:45 PM. Comp: $75 grocery-delivery credit. **Outcome:** 5-star review, "they didn't just clean it, they replaced the filter and brought us groceries to apologize. Best vacation rental management we've ever booked with."

### Case C — PC-15 (The Tinder Box), Apr 28

(Not a save — a loss to learn from.) Guest party of 4 in 2BR/1BA had a friend show up uninvited; we got a noise complaint at 11:14 PM from the neighbor. By the time AI Ambassador's auto-decline / quiet-hours reminder fired, neighbor had called HOA. HOA issued a $150 fine to the property. Guest was apologetic, paid the fine via stay credit. **Outcome:** 4-star review (good guest, bad event). **Lesson:** the friend-group inquiry from this guest had "5–6 of us" originally, scoped down to "4" — should have triggered a deeper pre-screen. Riley updating triage rubric to require explicit headcount confirmation for any friend-group inquiry.
